thread:
maria: Customer asks for HSM-backed key provenance and attestation proof for on-prem Private deployment. They want chain-of-custody, per-key rotation history, and evidence that RBAC changes are logged and correlated to key usage. Any quick answers before the QSA call tomorrow?
sam: Quick Qs: are they asking for single-tenant HSM (FIPS/HSM module) attestation or just KMS envelope logs? Do they require hardware attestation docs (TPM/AK certs)?
maria: They explicitly wrote 'hardware attestation + exportable audit trail'. Also asked whether we can map specific API tokens/service accounts to key unwrap events.
jordan: We can: on Private we support customer-managed HSM with attestation (YubiHSM/Azure HSM/CloudHSM options). For key usage correlation we emit audit events: `kms.key.unwrap`, `kms.key.wrap`, `kms.key.rotate` with a `principal_id` and `request_id`.
ken: Note: need to caveat on HSM vendor — some vendors redact serials in attestation PDFs. We should list supported vendors and what we can export. I'll pull vendor footnotes.
sec-bot: Reminder: security-review-call scheduled <@maria> at 11:00am PST tomorrow. Agenda pinned. :alarm_clock:
maria: Good. Jordan, can you paste an example of the audit log fields we can export? The customer wants csv-friendly evidence.
jordan: Sure — sample snippet (ELK query results):
```
{"ts":"2025-06-12T16:11:02Z","event":"kms.key.unwrap","key_id":"projA/key-03","principal_id":"svc-dataflow@acme.com","action":"unwrap","request_id":"req_8a1f","region":"us-west1","hsm_attestation_id":"hsm-az-42"}
```
We also include a `rbac_change_id` when a role grant/revoke is performed so you can correlate `rbac.change` events to subsequent key ops.
sam: Good. For the questionnaire: we should provide a matrix: evidence type (attestation PDF, audit export, RBAC change log, rotation proof) + sample retention period + how to request exports. I'll draft it.
maria: Also they asked about proof of key rotation. We support signed rotation statements — can we export rotation sigs?
ken: Yes — rotation statements are signed by the HSM and we store a copy in the audit bucket for Private. Example file name: `rotation/projA/key-03/2025-04-01.signed.json`. We can provide the raw signature + verification steps for their cryptographer.
jordan: Add note: if a customer wants end-to-end chain-of-custody, we recommend enabling `prefix-caching=false` for those keys to avoid server-side caching that hides intermediate unwrap events.
sam: Also a quick vuln-triage note: if any CVE hits the HSM vendor, our incident playbook triggers key rotation + attestation re-validation for affected tenants. We need to include that in the incident response section of the questionnaire.
maria: Can someone draft the short paragraph for the questionnaire about incident response actions and attach the sample log extract? I can handle the call but need the text now.
ken: I'll draft the incident blurb and attach rotation example to the shared drive. Draft: "Upon detection of vendor or cryptographic compromise we rotate affected keys, publish HSM attestation re-validation, and provide per-customer signed rotation artifacts and audit exports. We correlate RBAC changes to key events via `rbac.change_id` and provide request-level trace evidence."
maria: Perfect. Sam — can you produce the matrix and a one-page CSV export sample?
sam: On it. Will upload `sq_evidence_matrix.csv` and a zipped example logs bundle to the drive in ~45m.
sec-bot: Upload reminder: please add artifacts to `drive:/security/customer-evidence/2555550001_acme` before call.
jordan: I'll also include a short how-to: `curl` examples to pull audit logs from private admin API and an example `jq` filter to extract unwrap events.
maria: Thanks all — this should cover the customer asks. I'll run the QSA call with these artifacts. :thumbsup:
